reports.title: CIFAR-10 Baseline Comparison
reports.description: Comparing ResNet and EfficientNet architectures on CIFAR-10

blocks.text: This report compares ResNet and EfficientNet architectures trained on CIFAR-10. We evaluate accuracy, training speed, and parameter efficiency.
EfficientNet-B2 achieves the highest validation accuracy (91.8%) with 5.3M parameters, compared to ResNet-50's 87.6% with 25.6M parameters.

reports.title: Sentiment Analysis Results
reports.description: Comparison of BERT variants for sentiment analysis on IMDB

blocks.text: We compare BERT-base, DistilBERT, and BERT-large for binary sentiment classification on the IMDB movie reviews dataset.
BERT-large achieves the best F1 score (0.908) but requires 4x more compute. DistilBERT offers the best speed-accuracy tradeoff at 0.871 F1 with 2x faster training.
